card.name: The verb close and clog
card.fires_on: The verb "close" (shut something) and the start of "clog" (c-log) right after a subject or "to". It appears in instructions and general descriptions of shutting or blocking.

modes.label: Clog
modes.description: The word "clog" split as c + log, describing blocking a tube or syringe.
